name: gamedeck
description: GameDeck monorepo: run everything locally from here.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix games/slice-frenzy install && npm --prefix games/picture-perfect install && npm --prefix games/lane-dash install && npm --prefix games/zip-to-victory install && npm --prefix games/strike-alley install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,slice,picture,lane,zip,strike -c green,blue,magenta,cyan,yellow,white,gray "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix games/slice-frenzy run dev" "npm --prefix games/picture-perfect run dev" "npm --prefix games/lane-dash run dev" "npm --prefix games/zip-to-victory run dev" "npm --prefix games/strike-alley run dev"
